title: ProfilesGetOutput
description: One member's descriptive profile projection (tenant bookkeeping columns stripped; endorsements projected as `{ count, endorserUserIds }` — viewer-independent so a recorded output replays actor-free), or an EXPLICIT miss. `found` is the branch flag: a chain gates on `{ falsy found }` for a real id that is not in the tenant. A missing/empty `userId` never reaches this shape — it is a typed node failure.

userId.description: The member's opaque `User.userId` — the key `get` was called with.

endorsements.description: Viewer-independent projection (no `endorsedByMe`) so a recorded output replays actor-free.

profile.description: The projected profile, or null when `found` is false. Descriptive fields (`jobTitle`, `bio`, `availability`, …) ride on `additionalProperties`; the pinned shape is the key + the endorsement projection.

found.description: Whether a profile for `userId` exists in the run's tenant.
